task.title: Add smart priority scoring to Renzo contacts
task.description:
Enhance the existing Renzo single-file HTML/JS app by adding smart priority scoring to contacts. Keep ALL existing functionality working exactly as-is. ADD ONLY these changes:

1. Add 3 new fields to the contact form: contractExpiry (date input, label 'Contract Expiry'), invoiceAmount (number input, label 'Outstanding Invoice $'), lastContactDate (date input, label 'Last Contact Date')

2. Add computePriorityScore(contact) function that returns 0-100:
- Days since lastContactDate: score += min(daysSince/90, 1) * 40
- Contract expiry urgency: if expiry within 90 days, score += (1 - daysUntil/90) * 30; if expired, score += 30
- Invoice amount: score += min(invoiceAmount/10000, 1) * 30
- Return Math.round(score)

3. Add computeOutreachTrigger(contact) function that returns the most urgent reason as a string:
- Check contract expiry first: 'Contract expires in X days' or 'Contract expired X days ago'
- Then invoice: 'Invoice $X,XXX outstanding'
- Then last contact: 'Not contacted in X days'
- Return the most urgent one

4. Show priority score badge on each contact row in the contacts table (colored: 80+ red, 50-79 amber, below 50 green)

5. Sort contacts table by priority score descending by default

6. In the AI message generation, include the trigger reason in the prompt and display it in the 'Why this message' info box

The existing app has: login (admin/renzo2024), contacts CRUD with localStorage, AI message generation calling Anthropic API, outreach queue, drafts, settings. Preserve all of this exactly. Only add the above.
